items.title: CVZone Academy - The New way of Learning Computer Vision
items.description: Link: https://computervision.zone/cv-academy/ Learn why computer vision needs explicit, auditable rules to operate safely alongside humans in real-world environments. We explore the fundamental role of computer vision across high-stakes industries, including self-driving cars and factory robotics. Unlike general AI image understanding that relies on probabilistic models, industrial applications require a different approach to ensure reliability. This breakdown explains the technical necessity of defined parameters when systems interact with people. By comparing autonomous systems with standard image processing, we highlight the constraints that make computer vision engineering unique. If you are building automated systems or working in robotics, understanding these safety requirements is essential for deployment. items.title: Learn Modern Computer Vision in 2026: From Basics to Advanced
items.description: Learn Computer Vision from scratch and build real-world AI applications using Python, OpenCV, MediaPipe, and Deep Learning. In this complete beginner-to-advanced course, you'll learn how computers see images, process video streams, detect faces, hands, body poses, objects, text, and much more. We'll start with the fundamentals of image processing, move into real-time AI applications, and finally explore advanced topics like text recognition, semantic segmentation, and image inpainting. 📌 What you'll learn: • OpenCV Fundamentals • Image & Video Processing • Face, Hand & Pose Detection • Object Detection & Custom Training • OCR (Text Detection) • Semantic Segmentation • Image Inpainting • Real-World Computer Vision Projects Whether you're interested in AI, robotics, automation, or computer vision engineering, this course will give you a practical roadmap to build your own vision-based applications. #computervision #OpenCV #Python #ArtificialIntelligence #DeepLearning #MachineLearning #Robotics #YOLO #MediaPipe 00:00 Intro 02:34 Introduction to Images 05:10 Installations 08:28 Reading Images Videos Webcams 22:37 Chapter 1 - Grayscale 26:59 Chapter 1 - Blur 29:15 Chapter 1 - Crop 32:27 Chapter 1 - Text 36:00 Chapter 1 - Shape Detection 49:56 Chapter 1 - Color Detection 59:19 Chapter 2 - Face Detection 01:09:07 Chapter 2 - Hand Detection 01:16:14 Chapter 2 - Body Detection 01:22:24 Chapter 2 - Object Detection 01:39:55 Chapter 2 - Custom Object Detection 01:55:49 Chapter 3 - Text Detection 02:14:20 Chapter 3 - Semantic Segmentation 02:20:44 Chapter 3 - Image Inpainting
